title: Chicago Tribune, Swiatkowski death notice naming the Totosz family (19 July 1964)
citation: Death notice, William Swiatkowski, Chicago Tribune, Sunday 19 July 1964, p. 39: "...fond brother of Theodore, Fred, and Irene Totosz." newspapers.com image 376257813.
notes: Bridges the gap between the Chicago birth on the obituary and the Des Moines life: it places the Totosz family in Calumet City, Illinois in 1964, and the Irene Totosz named here then appears in the Des Moines Public Library index dying in Des Moines in March 1983 — very likely Ron’s mother. Cited only for that family connection; it says nothing about Ron himself, who is not named in it.
